usage: The term 'wild animal' refers to any animal living naturally in the wild.
You can use 'wild animal' as the subject or object in a sentence.
When talking about habitats or conservation, 'wild animal' is commonly used.
'Wild animal' can also be used to contrast with pets or domestic animals.
It is mainly used as a countable noun, but often in general statements, it can be plural without change.
